projects.geonus.desc: An adaptation of GeoGuessr for NUS made during Hack&Roll 2025. Made use of crowdsourced photos instead of StreetView so that users can submit unique photos and contribute to the game.

projects.klinix.desc: A desktop app targeted towards general practitioners. Klinix helps them to quickly access and keep track of patient records, appointments, and medicine needs.
